{{Quote|The Separatists are also on the run. We managed to save most of our troops.''"<br />"''How? It looked like they were rolling right over us.''"<br />"''That's how.''"<br />"''Whoa!|[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Kornell Divini]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[D'Arc Vaetes]], upon seeing the ''Resolution'' having repelled the Confederate forces|<ref name="MedStar II" />}}
The '''''Resolution''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the ''Resolution'' was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] to evacuate the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] on the world. The ''Resolution'' was successful in [[Battle of Drongar|its task]], evacuating most of the Republic forces and staff, driving back the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]], and securing a considerable amount of the precious [[Bota/Legends|bota]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].

==Description==
The ''Resolution'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was active in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="MedStar II" /> The ship was 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, 548 meters wide and 268 meters high.<ref name="CCS" /> The ''Resolution'' was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]<ref name="MedStar II" /> and armed with eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], fifty-two point-defense [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors and four heavy [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] tubes.<ref name="CCS" />

==History==
{{Quote|That's a Republic Star Destroyer. ''Venator''-class.''"<br />"''The ''Resolution''. Sent here to mop up and escort us back to the Core systems.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Erel Kersos]], about the ''Resolution''|<ref name="MedStar II" />}}
As a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer, the ''Resolution'' was manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="CCS" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was sent to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] where Republic and Confederate forces [[Battle of Drongar|fought]] against each other to gain control of the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] fields on the world. Bota was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] with substantial medicinal qualities. However, when the bota [[Mutant|mutated]] during that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and became useless, the Republic decided to pull out of Drongar, and the ''Resolution'' was tasked to escort the Republic forces on the planet back to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. After arriving over the planet, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fought off the Confederate [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]&mdash;who had started an offensive to secure most of the bota&mdash;and was able to evacuate most of the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces, along with the medical personnel stationed there. Also, the Republic saved two metric tons of non-mutated bota. Afterward, the ''Resolution'', together with a Republic [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]] that contained [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and personnel, jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], with its destination being the Core Worlds.<ref name="MedStar II" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Resolution'' appeared in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', the second novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. Published in [[2004]], ''Jedi Healer'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
